design.statistic: mean over five seeds per model, then difference

conditional_within_family_accuracy.meaning: among this family's cases predicted inside the family, share with the exactly right class; cases predicted in the other family are not in the denominator, so this is not overall accuracy

family_level_accuracy.meaning: share of this family's cases whose predicted class is in the same family (ignores which class inside)

conditional_within_family_accuracy.meaning: among this family's cases predicted inside the family, share with the exactly right class; cases predicted in the other family are not in the denominator, so this is not overall accuracy

family_diagnostic.note: Families follow the D1 category names. They do not prove a fault physically affects only pods or only VMs.
